The 賞与支払届 is due within 5 days (健保則 art.27, 厚年則 art.19の5). A bonus for a period over six months is BONUS_OVER_SIX_MONTHS (所得税法 art.186(2)).

references.title: 所得税法 art.186(2): where the bonus computation period exceeds six months and the 月額表 method applies, the bonus is divided by twelve, not six. Otherwise as BONUS: 標準賞与額 for social insurance, a wage for labour insurance.

労働基準法 art.26: for a shutdown attributable to the employer, at least 60% of the average wage (art.12; entry.facts.average_daily_wage) for each day (entry.quantity days); the larger of the amount entered and that minimum is paid. It is a wage: remuneration, labour insurance wages and salary income. The average wage is computed from the three calendar months' wages before the shutdown over their calendar days (art.12(1); earned.months) unless entered (entry.facts.average_daily_wage); for a partial-day shutdown the floor is 60% less the wages paid for that day (entry.facts.wages_paid_for_days; 昭和27年8月7日 基収3445号). The 平均賃金 leaves out the periods art.12(3) lists, their days and their wages: occupational injury absence, 産前産後休業, an employer-caused suspension (suspension_kind EMPLOYER_CAUSED only, with the 休業手当 paid for it), 育児休業 (incl. 出生時育児休業), 介護休業 (earned.months leave_days, suspended_days_by_kind) and the probation period (terms.facts.probation_until, its wages prorated by calendar days); where they cover the whole three months the wages and days of the period are used undivided (施行規則 art.3; 昭和24年4月11日 基発421号), and a worker paid by the day or hour is guaranteed 60% of the three months’ wages over the days worked (art.12(1)(i); worked_days).

name: 食事の現物支給 (meals in kind)

references.title: 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (as amended 令和8年3月31日, from 1 April 2026: 7,500 yen; before: 3,500 yen): meals in kind are not taxable where the employee pays half or more of their value and the employer's cost is 7,500 yen a month or less; otherwise the employer's cost (value less the employee's payment) is taxable salary (entry.facts.meal_value, entry.facts.employee_payment). For social insurance the meal is valued at the 厚生労働大臣 告示 価額 of the prefecture and included in the grade the pension office decides (健康保険法 art.46). The social-insurance value is the 告示 price, entered as MEALS_IN_KIND_SOCIAL_INSURANCE.

所得税基本通達 36-45, 36-47: a 使用人 who pays half or more of the 通常の賃貸料の額 has no taxable benefit; otherwise the 通常の賃貸料 less the rent paid is taxable salary (entry.facts.standard_rent, entry.facts.rent_paid). An officer (terms.work_classification OFFICER) has no half-rent exemption: the 通常の賃貸料 under 36-40 and 36-41 (the employer computes it) less the rent paid is taxable whenever the rent is lower (国税庁 タックスアンサー No.2600). Housing in kind is remuneration at the 告示 価額 for social insurance (健康保険法 art.46). The social-insurance value is the 告示 price, entered as HOUSING_IN_KIND_SOCIAL_INSURANCE.

name: 課税される経済的利益 (other taxable benefit)

references.title: 所得税法 art.36(1)–(2) with 所得税基本通達 36-15 ff.: other benefits in kind (goods, services, low-interest loans, awards in money) are salary at their value as the 通達 states; the employer enters the taxable value.

name: 臨時の手当 (other taxable cash allowance)

references.title: 所得税法 art.28: a cash allowance paid in the month is salary income, remuneration for social insurance (健保法 art.3(5)) and a wage for labour insurance — including any excess over the night-duty or night-meal limits.

name: 宿日直手当 (night and holiday duty allowance)

references.title: 所得税基本通達 28-1: a 宿直・日直 allowance up to 4,000 yen an occasion is not taxable (entry.quantity occasions; the class pays at most that, any excess is SPECIAL_ALLOWANCE). It is 報酬 for social insurance (健康保険法 art.3(5); 日本年金機構 lists 宿日直手当 as 報酬) and a wage for labour insurance (労働保険徴収法 art.2(2)).

name: 深夜勤務の夜食代 (night-shift meal money)

references.title: 昭和59年7月26日 直法6-5 as amended 令和8年3月31日: cash paid instead of a meal for night work (22:00–05:00) is not taxable up to 650 yen an occasion (entry.quantity; from 1 April 2026 650, before 300). references.title: 所得税基本通達 36-21: an award in kind (not cash) for 10 or more years of service, at intervals of 5 years or more and of a reasonable value, is not taxable; a cash award or one outside these conditions is TAXABLE_BENEFIT or BONUS.
